### Helper models

None. This attack drives no model of its own, so `roles` can be left out.

### Parameters

Settings for the algorithm itself, written under the attack's `parameters`. Anything left out keeps its default.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `encoding_mode` | one of `word_replacement`, `mirror`, `rotate`, `base64`, `mixed` | `word_replacement` | How the goal is hidden in the image: word_replacement swaps words for decoys and gives the mapping in the text, mirror flips the image, rotate turns it 180 degrees, base64 draws the Base64 encoding, and mixed replaces words then mirrors and rotates. |
| `image_width` | integer (>= 100) | `800` | Width of the generated image, in pixels. |
| `image_height` | integer (>= 100) | `400` | Height of the generated image, in pixels. |
| `font_size` | integer (>= 8) | `24` | Font size of the text drawn in the image. |
| `background_color` | string | `white` | Background color of the image: a color name or a hex code. |
| `text_color` | string | `black` | Color of the text drawn in the image: a color name or a hex code. |
| `num_replacements` | integer (>= 1) | `3` | For word_replacement and mixed: how many words of the goal are swapped for decoy words in the image; the text lists each decoy with the word it replaces. |
| `prompt_style` | one of `game`, `control` | `game` | How the target is asked to decode the image: game frames it as a screen in a villain's lair to fill in, control as a neutral empty list to complete. |

### In a campaign file

```yaml
attacks:
- name: mml
```
